martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, cycling looks perfect today, especially between 8 and 10 when it's a pleasant 23°C with comfortable humidity. The average wind speed is around 11 km/h, so it shouldn't be too much of a hassle. Why not drag Britt along for a ride and then surprise them with a cold drink at the turnaround point?

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, perfect morning for a cycle, isn't it? The 08:00–10:00 window looks great, with a comfortable 23°C and gentle 11 km/h breeze. If Martha's free, maybe drag her along for a ride, and then you can both enjoy a drink on the terrace afterwards.
